summary: With some RSVP-TE optimizations, an ingress router can receive reservation messages before every downstream node has installed forwarding state. If it starts sending traffic right away, packets may be lost. This standards-track RFC defines LSP Self-Ping, where the ingress sends probe packets to itself through the path to confirm it is ready.

eli5.summary: Before sending a parade down a new road, you toss a ball down it to see if it comes back. If it does, the road works.
